chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah al-Dihqan, from Durust ibn Abu Mansur, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), that he used to say:
Folding the clothes is their resting, and it is more lasting for them.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of folding clothes according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) teaches that folding garments allows them to 'rest,' a concept reflecting the Shia emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) extending to inanimate objects to prevent creasing and wear. This practical advice is rooted in the broader Islamic principle of stewardship (*khilafah*) over one's possessions, encouraging mindfulness and care in daily routines as an act of worship.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ubeydullah Bin Abdullah Al Dagqan, from Dorost Bin Abu Mansour, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> was saying:
‘Folding the clothes is its resting, and it is more lasting for it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from [his father] from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Ubayd Allah ibn ‘Abd Allah al-Dihqan from Durust ibn abu Mansur from Ibrahim ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Folding clothes is giving them rest and durability.’”
